No degree-at-most-three order-two projective closure appears in the pole-order-three exact-form ansatz
operations.summary: Across primes 1009 and 1013, primitive degrees 0..3 and scalar degrees 0..3 all have dt2_relation_dimension zero. This is only a replicated finite bound.

operations.title: Nima reports the replicated order-two projective Krylov exclusion
operations.body: The module-first ladder now excludes genuine order-two closure for primitive/scalar degrees 0..3 with pole-order-three primitives, over primes 1009 and 1013. All 32 dt2 relation dimensions are zero; at degree (3,3), ranks are 36 -> 44 -> 48 in both primes. This remains a finite bound, not a rank theorem. Next admissible rung is order three/pole order four.
